plugin.name: Aardwolf_Utility_Aliases
plugin.author: FesterHead
plugin.purpose: Executes custom sequences of commands via aliases
plugin.description: Provides handy alias sequences: - 'ppp': Auto-retrieves, holds, enters, removes, and bags a portal. - 'dsa': Drop all, sac all, and look.

alias.name: UsePortalSequence
alias.send: RunCommands({ "get portal from bag", "hold portal", "enter", "remove portal", "put portal in bag", "wear candle" })

muclient.script:
-- Utility function to execute a table of commands sequentially function RunCommands(commands) for _, cmd in ipairs(commands) do Execute(cmd) end end
function OnPluginInstall() Note("-> Utility Aliases Plugin Loaded. 'ppp' and 'dsa' aliases are active.") end
